chunks: Jamīl ibn Darrāj narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
Regarding a man who prayed five rakʿahs: if he sat in the fourth for the duration of the tashahhud, then his worship is valid.

key_terms.التَّشَهُّدِ: the prescribed testimony recited while seated in prayer
key_terms.الرَّابِعَةِ: the fourth rakʿah, the normal completion point of a four-rakʿah prayer
key_terms.خَمْسًا: five rakʿahs, meaning an extra unit was added
key_terms.عِبَادَتُهُ: his act of worship, here referring to the prayer

ai.seo_question: Is the salat (prayer) valid if someone accidentally prays five rakʿahs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning forgetfulness in salat (prayer). It states that if a person unintentionally prays a fifth rakʿah but had already sat in the fourth rakʿah for the amount of time of the tashahhud, then the prayer remains valid.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1016 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from him (as) that He said: "
If a man prays five rak'ahs and sits in the fourth rak'ah for the duration of the tashahhud, then his worship is valid."
